description: This Java class implements a health check supplier for Akka Management, checking whether the GatewayRootActor has started the HTTP route by sending a message and awaiting a response.

classes.name: GatewayHttpReadinessCheck
classes.description: A final class that implements Supplier<CompletionStage<Boolean>>, providing a health check for the gateway's HTTP readiness.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous check to see if the GatewayRootActor responds with 'ready', indicating the HTTP route is active.
